node.statement: By 1.7.1 the thresholds have the required universal ranges. For the arbitrary instance fixed in 1.7.2, nodes 1.7.2 and 1.7.3 establish the two group-law guards and the polar-retraction guard. Node 1.7.4 gives the root's explicit C^1 diffeomorphism and unique inverse (u_pol,h_pol); node 1.7.5.1 gives the C^1 formulas, three exact identities, and five estimates with bound A*epsilon_r for u_grp; and node 1.7.7, using lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality, gives u_grp=u_pol on S_delta and hence for every value used by those formulas. Substitution transfers all group conclusions to the root-bound u_pol. Since epsilon_r>=0 and A=C_grp^0<=C_grp, A*epsilon_r<=C_grp*epsilon_r. The instance was arbitrary, so these witnesses prove the root contract.
